sources.title: Tencent Hunyuan Hy-Memory 2.0: A 30B MoE Memory Writer That Beats Opus ...
sources.snippet: Tencent Hunyuan released Hy-Memory 2.0 on October 16, 2026: the Hy-Memory-30B-A3B memory writer (30B MoE, 3B active), the Hy-Memory engine and the MemHub app, all under Apache-2.0. The write path is trained with reinforcement learning and validated across Mem0, MemOS and EverMemOS. This guide covers the benchmark breakdown, running it with vLLM, how MemHub shares one memory across ten AI tools ...
